Definition
[Component representation of the rough Laplacian] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0297 ↗ appa-def-component-representation ↗ appa-def-rough-laplacian 1. Section A.4\group second-order-differential-operators

In local coordinates, the component representation of the rough Laplacian is \[ \Delta A^{k_1\cdots k_q}_{j_1\cdots j_p} := (\Delta A)\! \left(\frac{\partial }{\partial x^i},\frac{\partial }{\partial x^{j_1}},\ldots ,\frac{\partial }{\partial x^{j_p}};dx^{k_1},\ldots ,dx^{k_q}\right). \]
